issues.message: Three web-lite adapter packages and hashes are staged and browser-smoke tested, but official platform policy verification and native-platform QA are absent; staging is not publish proof.
IAA runtime branches now update delivery/gull/offline state, but no platform ad SDK integration or end-state reward receipt evidence is available.
Six-area progression, contiguous camera origins and web-lite area switching are now built; per-area production chains and native-platform camera/layout are still absent.
